name: silver-screen-subtitles
title: Silver Screen Subtitles
description: Cinema-grade subtitles: word-wrapped to 42 characters per line (the industry standard), timed against a playhead, positioned bottom-centre with a safety margin, and re-rendered per cue without animation jank.
designRules:
# Design System

Genre: Editorial
Macrostructure: Stack
Density: Medium
Shape: Sharp
Motion: None
Typography: Grotesk
Color: High Contrast

## Rules

- Playhead Sync: the interaction model is part of the design, not an add-on.
- Reduced motion replaces animation with a state change; nothing is hidden behind motion.
- The component composes through `cn` and never hardcodes colours.

## Avoid

- Reskinning this resource and republishing it under a new name.
- Adding shadows or radii that contradict its shape language.
